study.question: After retaining exact conjunctive content and counts, must a representation unit encode the temporal placement of the conjunction itself, or is placement of the two constituent field relations sufficient?
study.hypothesis: The occupancy result suggests that coarse placement, rather than within-conjunction content-order covariance, carries the recent pair-rank gain. A symmetric mean of the two marginal-relation centroids may retain most of that gain when multiplying the SAME true conjunctive content. This is a prospective lower-order representation replacement, not a claim that it already improves quality or has lower measured cost. The competing hypothesis is that conjunction-specific placement is essential.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary text lines271-283 verifies unnormalized target activation pooling. Retain that inherited component; replace only an existing conjunctive-placement source, not DIN attention normalization. No claim of exact original DIN reproduction.

Pinned benchmark forward/tokenizer lines113-159 pools history with target attention, tokenizes fields/tasks and applies interaction. Inherited local model similarly combines static/history tokens, but the proposed contrast is pair versus marginal rank-centroid binding before its existing interaction block. Benchmark code is not an original-author method audit.

Pinned benchmark block lines221-243 repeatedly encodes sequences, decodes global queries and boosts field/global tokens. No such architecture is newly added here; only an existing fixed summary source changes. Original paper detailed text is unavailable through the authorized registry.

Pinned benchmark block lines187-197 mixes non-sequential queries, retrieves through cross attention and fuses per layer. This experiment preserves the inherited fixed summary and one-block interaction instead of adopting repeated evolving queries.

study.proposed_difference: Replace only mu_rs in the existing input O_rs=mu_rs*S_rs by mu_marg=(mu_r+mu_s)/2. Here S_rs is exactly the existing FP32 signed target-weighted content sum on conjunction support /sqrt(7); mu uses unweighted counts and the inherited centered unit-RMS rank basis q within each temporal bin. mu_r=sum(mask_r*q)/max(n_r,1). Both sources and all inherited pair-moment computations run in both cells. The joint cell returns the exact parent occupancy expression. No new parameters/tokens, timestamps, labels, input features or loss mechanisms. The candidate does not claim a runtime reduction because matched computation is retained.
predictions: If lower-order placement is sufficient in this setting, the marginal replacement should retain most of the incumbent occupancy improvement over g0-r0016-pair_rank_zero while using the same true pair content. The historical occupancy-minus-zero macro AUC gain is 0.0004773226936833. A replacement delta within +/-0.0001 is a descriptive near-null band, not a significance/equivalence claim or a selection veto.

If conjunction-specific placement is necessary, marginal replacement should lose validation macro AUC relative to matched joint occupancy, potentially approaching the existing copy/zero controls. The old marginal rank control is not a clean test because it also changes content allocation.

Both modes should be identical before training because the existing pair-rank bank starts at zero, and joint mode should reproduce the parent after training under deterministic execution. Synthetic nonzero-bank tests must distinguish the two modes on nonidentical supports.

Helper output is zero on empty conjunction support regardless of populated marginals; identical marginal supports give identical centroids; short/nested supports can cause the modes to coincide. Full trained empty-history slice equality is not predicted, because gradients from other samples can alter shared parameters.
falsifiers: A material drop outside the descriptive near-null band, especially repeated on a second authorized paired seed, contradicts marginal-placement sufficiency for this architecture. A single noisy drop remains provisional.

A difference between joint replay and the incumbent under the same host recipe invalidates the intended matched comparison until the cause is understood; it is not a scientific rejection of either centroid mechanism.

Nonfinite values, nonzero helper output on empty pair support, padding sensitivity, current-action sensitivity, changed parameter/init/RNG state, or unchanged outputs in a synthetic discriminating nonzero-bank example invalidates implementation readiness.
Marginal matching joint does not establish a new mechanism or efficiency improvement. A candidate gain without an active matched control and repetition cannot establish mechanism superiority.
alternative_explanations: The marginal centroid is a symmetric approximation, not an unbiased estimate of the joint centroid. Input variances and effective rank differ despite equal parameter counts.
Nested item attributes can make marginal and joint centroids coincide or highly correlate; a null contrast does not prove general redundancy.
This seed and validation set have already been used adaptively in many rounds. One additional run cannot establish significance or equivalence.
Summary source changes can affect optimization and Dice batch statistics later in training. Equal initialization does not isolate the learned downstream response.
The exposed slices do not include pair-occupancy/nesting counts or user IDs for a paired cluster bootstrap; those analyses are unavailable in this coding phase.
